description: How Facebook ads helped turn a packed room into over $2M for our client.  #justinlalonde
transcript: I've now had the chance to partner with several local events and masterminds, all of which had several thousand people in attendance through the power of Facebook ads. Now we're talking rooms that collected and sold over two million dollars in 24 hours, just from the people in attendance. In the room itself, about 900 people present gave retake. Our client ended up pitching a $10,000 product that they have. Now out of that room, about 20% gave retake were a little more converted. So it was the actual numbers, 217 people ended up closing on this $10,000 offer, which is $2.17 million on top of the close to half a million dollars in ticket sales. Now, all in all, it costed when I say us, I mean our client, about half a million dollars in ad spend, plus in event team and material and so on and so forth. So event cost, so about half a million dollars to organize and throw down this event and fill out the room to then sell. If you count the ticket sales about 2.5 to 2.6 million dollars worth of products during this event. So again, very profitable event when you see it that way.
